appDescription.message: Skip ads in Bilibili videos automatically by AI

emptyGeminiApiBaseUrlHint.message: Leave empty to use the official Gemini endpoint

emptyOpenAiApiBaseUrlHint.message: Leave empty to use the official OpenAI endpoint

openAiApiBaseUrlHint.message: Enter the base URL for the OpenAI Responses API. Leave it empty to use the official endpoint. For example: https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://your-proxy.example.com/v1. Do not enter a full endpoint path such as /responses.

emptyApiBaseUrlHint.message: Leave empty to use the official Gemini endpoint

invalidApiBaseUrl.message: Invalid URL format. Use an address starting with http:// or https://

openAiEndpointPathNotSupported.message: Enter only the OpenAI base URL, not a full endpoint path such as /responses or /chat/completions.

httpsPageCannotUseHttpApiBaseUrl.message: The Bilibili page is HTTPS, so it cannot call an HTTP AI endpoint directly. Use an HTTPS endpoint or place an HTTPS reverse proxy in front of it.

noApiKeyProvided.message: No API key provided. Please configure in settings.

aiNotInitialized.message: AI not initialized. Please configure API key in extension settings.

aiServiceFailed.message: Failed to reach AI service. Please check your network connection.

aiServiceAuthFailed.message: The AI service returned 401 Unauthorized. Check whether the API key in the popup is the CPA proxy token and whether the server accepts Authorization: Bearer.

aiServiceForbidden.message: The AI service returned 403 Forbidden. Check server permissions, origin restrictions, and model access policy.

aiServiceServerError.message: The AI service returned a 5xx server error. Check the CPA service or upstream model logs first.

aiServiceTlsFailed.message: The HTTPS connection failed. Check whether the certificate is trusted by this browser and whether the hostname exactly matches the certificate SAN.

aiServiceCorsFailed.message: The browser blocked the cross-origin request. Check whether CPA allows CORS from https://www.bilibili.com and permits the Authorization header.

aiServiceTimeout.message: The AI request timed out. Check the CPA endpoint, network connectivity, and server processing time.

aiServiceNetworkFailed.message: Unable to establish a network connection to the AI service. If you use a self-signed HTTPS certificate, check the trust chain and browser console first.

failedToDownloadModel.message: Failed to download model. Please try again.

browserModelNotSupported.message: The feature is not supported in this browser.

modelIsDownloading.message: Model is downloading. Please try again later.

notLoginYet.message: Not login yet. Please login first.
